data.title: Kitchen and Playground Matter Hunt
data.description: Let us discover how everyday objects act like solids, liquids, and gases when we look closely at them!

objects.name: garden rock
objects.imagePrompt: A smooth gray rock sitting on green grass in a sunny garden

objects.name: drinking water
objects.imagePrompt: A clear glass filled with refreshing cold water and condensation drops

objects.name: air
objects.imagePrompt: Green open outdoor park with gentle wind blowing colorful leaves

objects.name: sweet honey
objects.imagePrompt: A honey dipper dripping thick golden honey into a small bowl

objects.name: steam
objects.imagePrompt: A hot cup of tea with white steam rising up into the air

objects.name: sandbox sand
objects.imagePrompt: A pile of golden brown playground sand under bright sunshine

challenges.instruction: What does the garden rock do when you put it into a cup?
challenges.narration: I wonder if this sturdy garden rock will change its shape when it goes inside a cup?

challenges.instruction: What does drinking water do when you pour it into a cup?
challenges.narration: Look how drinking water splashes and moves around! Let us see how it fits inside its new container.

challenges.instruction: What does air do when it is inside an empty space or a room?
challenges.narration: We cannot always see air, but it is all around us. Let us figure out how it behaves in the room!

challenges.instruction: What does sweet honey do when you pour it into a cup?
challenges.narration: Sweet honey is so thick and slow, but watch closely to see how it settles in the cup!
